title: Adaptive recruitment of cortex-wide recurrence for visual object recognition (EEG)
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from 34 participants (one session each) who viewed 242 object images, 121 challenge and 121 control images, selected from comparisons between human behavioural performance and AlexNet. The study examines adaptive recruitment of cortex-wide recurrent processing during visual object recognition. The derivatives folder contains outputs of the decoding analyses, including time-resolved decoding accuracy matrices for object identity (.npz).
methods_description: Each trial showed a single image for 200 ms followed by a 100 ms blank. Trials were grouped into sequences of 14 images. At the end of each sequence, participants reported whether a paper clip had appeared in that sequence. One EEG session was recorded per participant.
